title: A meal ends; its reputation remains
literal_meaning: One day’s rice; ages of reputation.
explanation: A brief occasion can leave a lasting impression, good or bad. Its memory outlasts the meal.
meaning_odia: ଭୋଜନ ଦିନକର, କିନ୍ତୁ ସେହି ଅବସରର ଭଲମନ୍ଦ ନାମ ବହୁଦିନ ରହିପାରେ।
usage_example: Guests remember a host’s considerate welcome long after the gathering ends. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The dictionary places କଥା here under fame or notoriety and labels the saying ପ୍ରବଚନ. No particular feast is identified.

witnesses.note: Exact saying before the dictionary’s genre label; no spelling normalization.

origin_note: Earliest use, regional distribution and original speaker are unverified.
